title: COVID Cases Contradiction Example
text: City X reported zero COVID cases yesterday. The same source confirmed a rise in cases earlier that day.

title: Political Statement Contradiction
text: The mayor denied any involvement in the scandal on Monday. However, the same mayor admitted to being aware of the issue in a statement released Sunday evening.
notes: Source consistency violation - same person contradicting themselves

title: Economic Report Contradiction
text: The quarterly report showed a 10% decline in revenue. The CEO announced record-breaking profits for the same quarter during the earnings call.
notes: Mutually exclusive statements about same time period

title: Weather Report (No Contradiction)
text: Weather forecast predicts rain for tomorrow. Today has been sunny and warm.

title: Event Ordering Violation
text: The company announced bankruptcy yesterday. Last week, they completed a successful merger that doubled their market value.
notes: Temporal inconsistency - how can bankruptcy follow a successful merger so quickly?

title: Multiple Sources (Consistent)
text: Source A reported that the event started at 3 PM. Source B independently confirmed that the event began at 3 PM.

title: Health Statistics Contradiction
text: The hospital announced zero patient admissions today. Emergency room staff reported being overwhelmed with patients throughout the day.
notes: Direct contradiction about same day events

title: Complex Multi-Event Timeline
text: The project was completed in January 2024. The team started working on it in March 2024. Initial planning happened in February 2024.
